term.label: TFRS_collection

definition.text: The possible discontinous stretch of DNA that encompass all the TFRSs that regulate a promoter.

comments: Added as per Mejia-Almonte et.al PMID:32665585. Moved from transcription_regulatory_region (SO:0001679) to transcriptional_cis_regulatory_region (SO:0001055) by Dave Sant on Feb 11, 2021 when transcription_regulatory_region was merged into transcriptional_cis_regulatory_region to be consistent with GO and reduce redundancy as part of the GREEKC consortium. See GitHub Issue #527.
